create.title: Hard-TOP square-product entry sector is power-safe
create.statement_tex: Let A_L(m,h)=1_(h in H_L)1_(m<=h<=4m)a_end(h,m)e(sqrt(Xhm)) be the literal hard-TOP matrix and A_L^square(m,h)=1_(hm is a square)A_L(m,h). If A_*=sup_(m,h)|a_end(h,m)|, then uniformly for |c_h|<=1, ||A_L^square c||_2^2<<A_*^2 L^(3/2), and ||A_L^square||_(HS)^2<<A_*^2 L log(2L). Indeed m=du^2 with d squarefree forces h=dv^2 and the hard support gives u<=v<=2u. Thus the actual character sector is O_epsilon(L^(3/2)X^epsilon), and the full target reduces by the norm triangle to the nonsquare complement A_L^ns=A_L-A_L^square. This is not an orthogonal energy split and is distinct from the primitive off-diagonal condition ab square.

create.title: Hard-TOP parity high-pass and ambient spectral bounds do not contract
create.statement_tex: Enumerate odd heights as h=h_0+2t and put z_t=v_h. Then E_L^top=||zhat(pi)||_2^2 and the spectral mean is D_L=sum_t||z_t||_2^2. The exact high-pass 2sum_t(-1)^t z_t=sum_t(-1)^t(z_t-z_(t+1)) has multiplier 1-e^(itheta), of modulus 2 at pi, so its selected energy is exactly 4E_L^top. More generally a finite height-only convolution either has nonzero symbol at pi and is invertible on the target coefficient, or kills pi and needs a separate estimate. If V e_h=v_h and U_chi=diag(chi_4(h)), V and VU_chi have identical singular values, so operator, Schatten, Frobenius, Schur, and coefficient-uniform Bessel estimates cannot gain merely from the character. Bounded vectors z_h=chi_4(h)w on the common literal affine interior attain diagonal capacity L^2 and parity energy L^3; this is a coefficient adversary, not an actual physical lower bound. The missing statement is a fixed actual-direction spectral-measure or one-sided real estimate.
create.next_action: Freeze parity-only filters, adjacent total variation, ambient singular values, and coefficient-uniform Bessel bounds. Reopen only with a kernel-dependent estimate of the fixed actual character direction.

create.title: Positive hard-TOP excess localizes to one complete signed offset family
create.statement_tex: Let Gamma_r be the literal one-orientation hard-TOP physical correlation, including chi_4(h)chi_4(h+2r)=(-1)^r, the exact common affine m-range, actual profiles, and every internal tag. Then E_L^top-D_L=2Re sum_(r>=1)Gamma_r. If Delta=E_L^top-D_L>0, one of O(log L) complete dyadic physical-r shells has real part at least Delta/O(log L). Directly partitioning the unique primitive labels gives the analogous conclusion for one complete dyadic q-shell; an r-shell is not identified with one q-shell because r=gq. At resolution 1<=R<=N_L, one consecutive interval of at most R physical offsets carries at least RDelta/(4N_L). Every lift, ceiling, reciprocal interval, collar, floor, star, metric centre, entry, exit, and one-count slab remains joint. This is a signed one-way inverse theorem, not a bound. The Round-110 completed-to-physical comparison is global in real part and supplies no shellwise completed connector.
create.next_action: Use only as an inverse localization after a positive excess. A continuation must bound a complete actual-symbol shell before any offsetwise modulus or slabwise norm, or prove a new shellwise completion connector.
